items.text: Malik Nabers (knee) situation murky for SNF; sounds like up to him. Giants elevated Braxton Berrios and Dalen Cambre. Main slate news mostly in.
items.why: Up to player post-ACL; elevations signal contingency.
items.implication: Have backup ready; monitor warmups closely.

items.text: Brock Bowers ruled out Week 1 after meniscus trim; expected miss game or two.
items.why: Meniscus procedure; coach confirmed out despite early optimism.
items.implication: Michael Mayer TE1 bump; Jeanty more featured.
items.opportunity: Mayer targets/routes spike in MIA-LV slow pace.

items.text: Saints RB Alvin Kamara questionable with MCL sprain not expected to play vs Lions; full participant late week but not ready.
items.why: Sources confirm not ready despite practice.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty (ankle) cleared/off injury report, good to go vs Dolphins after full practices.
items.why: Full week practice; feels really good.
items.implication: Start Jeanty as workhorse; workload may be managed slightly.
items.opportunity: High snap/rush share with Bowers out.

items.text: Cardinals rookie RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle sprain) expected to play vs Chargers.
items.implication: Lock in Love; reverse Allgeier contingency.

items.text: Bears WR Rome Odunze (calf) expected to go vs Panthers.
Updated snaps/pace: NO@DET up in pace; MIA@LV slow slog. CHI/CAR total jumped. Factor Tua/Bowers news.
items.implication: Favor NO/DET skill; fade MIA/LV volume.
items.opportunity: Higher plays for Saints/Lions; lower for Dolphins/Raiders.

items.text: Isaiah Likely love: ranks high pts/target; Nabers won't be 100%; Giants WR2 weak (Fields/Mooney). Gimme all the Likely.
items.why: Fact: high efficiency; Nabers limited upside.
items.implication: Start Likely especially if Nabers limited/out.
items.opportunity: TE targets in two-TE sets or Nabers absence.

items.text: Steelers CB Joey Porter Jr unlikely to play vs Falcons (back) amid contract dispute; trade possible.
Maxx Crosby will play for Raiders; shut down trade talks post-Ravens nix.
items.why: Told teams including Rams he did not want trade.
items.implication: Raiders DL at full strength vs MIA.

items.text: Chuba Hubbard flex play this week but viable; keeping it open on The Chubbler.
items.why: Viable flex amid Brooks return uncertainty.

items.text: Christian McCaffrey buy-low: not worried about preseason usage/Kaelon Black; banged up, long flight, weird game.
items.why: Contrarian on early freakout; expect bounce.

items.text: Saquon Barkley vs WAS: averages 136.5 rush yds/6.0 YPC and 21+ PPR in 4 games vs Commanders.
items.why: Historical dominance; WAS front still below avg.

items.text: Chris Olave with Tyler Shough: 29% target share, 14.7+ PPR in 75% games last year; Shough waiver streaming QB.
